mapper.select: SELECT n.notification_id, n.type, n.title, n.body, n.link_url, n.created_at, nd.read_at IS NOT NULL AS read FROM notification n LEFT JOIN notification_delivery nd ON nd.notification_id = n.notification_id AND nd.channel = 'IN_APP' WHERE n.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY n.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
